name: gfx_copy_rect_to_copy_page

name: gfx_colour
notes: §2 colour used by the drawing routines

name: dissolve_page1_to_0
notes: §4 64 steps; each copies one pixel of every 8x8 block of page 1 (D9B8) to page 0 (D9B6) and waits for a tick_counter change

name: dissolve_order
notes: §4 pixel offset of each step within its block row

name: dissolve_rows
notes: §4 VGA: block row offset / 8 by step & 7

type: far u16(u16 x0 u16 x1 u16 y0 u16 y1 u16 dx u16 dy_bottom u16 src u16 dst)

name: ega_pal_set
notes: §2 EGA/CGA palette entry; nothing in mode 13h

name: gfx_colour_map
notes: §1 gfx_set_colour's map of colours 0-1Fh to the mode's (copied by gfx_set_mode from DD61 / DD81 / DDA1)

name: colour_map_2
notes: §1 the map of the 2-colour modes (6; 0Bh / 0Ch; 11h): colour & 1

name: colour_map_4
notes: §1 the map of the CGA 4-colour modes 4 / 5: colour & 3

name: colour_map_16
notes: §1 the map of the 16-colour modes (Tandy 8-0Ah; EGA 0Dh-10h / 12h): colour & 0Fh; also mode 12h's attribute palette (INT 10h AX=1002h)

name: gfx_dither
notes: §2 per colour 0-1Fh: its fill on even rows and on odd rows (CGA / Tandy: a byte of pixels; EGA: a colour each); picture_hline fills with it; copied by gfx_set_mode from DE01 / DE41 / DE81; ega_pal_set sets entries

name: dither_4
notes: §2 gfx_dither of the CGA 4-colour modes (colour c: c * 55h)

name: dither_16
notes: §2 gfx_dither of the 16-colour modes (Tandy: c * 11h; EGA: the colour)

name: herc_bda
notes: §1 the BIOS data (0040:0049..0058) of the Hercules modes 0Bh / 0Ch

name: herc_crtc
notes: §1 the Hercules CRTC registers of modes 0Bh / 0Ch (index | value << 8)

name: gfx_bitmap_pattern
notes: §2 the colour's pixel pattern (both bytes) of the CGA / Tandy bitmap paths (gfx_draw_bitmap / gfx_read_bitmap)
